name: sources
description: A /sources pane listing every web page Claude fetched or saw in search results this session, deduplicated by URL, with a button that inserts them as citations into your prompt

citation_format.title: Citation format
citation_format.description: How Insert citations writes the list: markdown (- [Title](url)) or numbered ([1] Title. url).

cite_search_results.title: Cite search results
cite_search_results.description: Also cite pages that only appeared in search results. Off: only pages Claude fetched successfully are cited.

extra_tools.title: Extra fetch tools
extra_tools.description: Comma-separated names of other tools that fetch a URL, recorded like WebFetch, e.g. mcp__fetch__fetch. Empty: WebFetch and WebSearch only.

url_arg.title: URL argument of extra tools
url_arg.description: The argument that holds the URL in the extra fetch tools' calls.

project_history.title: Keep project history
project_history.description: Also keep the sources of every session in this project, on disk in the plugin's store, and add a pane button to show them.
